title: DesignIndexDocumentDeletedPayload
description: design.index_document.deleted v1 (OpenVibe.Design server/search-index.js, via openvibe-publishing/search-feed). A Search tombstone for an icon or theme page that left the catalog. Only sent for a page Search was sent before. Consumed by OpenVibe.Search ('*.index_document.*'). Envelope: subject { type, id, revision }, visibility internal, actor service:design.

revision.description: Index revision of the tombstone; wins over any document at the same or an older revision.
